scheme_name: Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers Under Coop. Fold
other_conditions: Applicant must be a member of a handloom cooperative society
Must have worked for at least 10 years under the cooperative society on the date of application
Should not have any source of income or pension from the State Government or Government of India
Should not be in a position to earn his/her livelihood
Should not have any relation who can maintain him/her
Residence condition may be relaxed by the State Government if it causes undue hardship
